pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Deulmak (Perilla Seed Makguksu)", "rating": 5.0 } --- A thick, nutty makguksu loaded with ground perilla seeds ``` ## Review There are so many types of makguksu out there, but the deulmak (perilla seed makguksu) here was a style I hadn't tried much before. The buckwheat itself already has a nutty aroma, and on top of that it's loaded with ground perilla seed powder, so the nuttiness is maximized — combined with a subtle sweetness, it's a flavor even kids would enjoy. It's mild and smooth rather than pungent, so I think people of all ages could enjoy it without any trouble. The portion can feel a bit small, so I'd definitely recommend getting the large size. For a side dish, it looked like most people were ordering the `mandu` (dumplings). ```adcard ``` If you're expecting an icy, chilled makguksu, you might be a little disappointed, but if you already enjoy the `perilla oil makguksu` style, you'll definitely love this one. There's usually a wait on weekends, but the restaurant has plenty of seating and it's the kind of meal people finish quickly, so you likely won't have to wait too long. There is a dedicated parking lot, but it doesn't have many spots. There's also a public parking lot nearby, but on weekends it's likely to be full. Parking here always seems to be a bit of a struggle on weekends. ## Pictures
